d:
The Congress and Samajwadi Party have begun formal seat-sharing talks ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. But their first meeting lasted just 20 minutes, with Congress reportedly seeking 130 seats. What does this mean for the alliance? Will the two parties find common ground, who will call the shots, and what role will Priyanka Gandhi play in the negotiations?
In conversation: Manoj CG, Neeta Sharma
Producer: Tista Roy Chowdhury
Editor: Prince Kesari
Camera: Madhur & Vikas
